News

Leading through the complexity of a dynamic environment

Published 14 October 2025 14 Oct 2025

Share

The recent Women UNLIMITED Leadership Summit featured a diverse array of perspectives on leadership styles and was led by distinguished presenters.

The summit, the largest Australian event organised by the Global Institute of Women in Leadership and The Hatchery, was held in seven locations across six states and territories, drawing over 2,000 participants.

Over 200 speakers including former US Secretary of State Hillary Rodham Clinton and The Hon. Julia Gillard AC, shared insights on their leadership journeys from dealing with and managing people, navigating global challenges and how to lead with strength in uncertain times.

Helen Vaughan, Victorian Commissioner for Environmental Sustainability presented at the summit about ‘Leading through the complexity of a dynamic environment'.

Commissioner Vaughan discussed her leadership journey from operational forester to Commissioner for Environmental Sustainability in Victoria. Commissioner Vaughan has spent her career understanding science and implementing scientific approaches to manage natural resources and emergency management.

Commissioner Vaughan said “In my experience working collaborative with the community and stakeholders helps to achieve better outcomes when different perspectives are considered and incorporated into decision making. Working honestly and respectfully helps build trust and leads to greater buy in of an approach.


Start by meeting people where they are at. We all have biases and experiences that influence our thinking. Listen, be open to questions and be willing to incorporate different perspectives where appropriate. Often incremental, careful change leads to better longer-term outcomes. In my view, trust comes from working honestly, sharing information and working respectfully.”

The summit was an opportunity hear from a diverse range of leaders from across sectors – both locally and globally, inspiring new thinking and momentum in pursuit of progress.
